title: The Penguin's Unresolved Falcone Sisters Story
excerpt:
The Penguin left Sofia Falcone with a letter from Selina Kyle.
A new editorial argues their shared family history deserves a follow-up.
body_md:
Matt Reeves' Batman universe has an unfinished thread involving Sofia Falcone and Selina Kyle. At the end of The Penguin, Sofia, now back in Arkham, receives a letter from Selina. Both women are daughters of Carmine Falcone, whose crimes shaped their lives in different ways.

Zoë Kravitz portrayed Selina in The Batman, where she helped Bruce Wayne uncover Gotham's corruption before leaving the city. Cristin Milioti's Sofia became a breakout character in The Penguin, battling Oz Cobb for control of the criminal underworld before being institutionalized again.

An editorial suggests a Catwoman-focused film or series could explore the half-sisters' relationship and provide closure to this part of the Reeves continuity. Neither such a project nor a reunion of the actresses has been officially confirmed. The proposal is speculation about a narrative opportunity, not a production announcement.
